name: Creamy Cauliflower Salad with Edamame, Celery & Dill
instructions: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut cauliflower into 1-inch florets and slice stems into smaller pieces.

Once the water comes to a boil, uncover, then add cauliflower, edamame, and salt; stir for a few seconds. Cook until cauliflower and edamame are tender-crisp, about 3 minutes. Drain and set aside to cool slightly.
Meanwhile, place mayo, Dijon, vinegar, sugar, and spices in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add dill, cauliflower, and edamame to the bowl; stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between bowls and enjoy!
author: Mealime
